description: This file defines the `SimpleQueueCacheCursor` class, which implements the `IQueueCacheCursor` interface. It manages cursor operations over a simple queue cache, providing methods for moving through cache items, retrieving current items, and handling caching logic within Orleans streaming infrastructure.

classes.name: SimpleQueueCacheCursor
classes.description: A cursor class for iterating over a simple queue cache in Orleans streaming, supporting navigation, state management, and logging.

methods.name: GetCurrent
methods.description: Returns the current batch container and any exception encountered.

methods.name: MoveNext
methods.description: Advances the cursor to the next message in the stream if available.

methods.name: Refresh
methods.description: Refreshes the cursor to a specific sequence token if not currently set.

methods.name: RecordDeliveryFailure
methods.description: Marks the current element as having a delivery failure.

methods.name: Dispose
methods.description: Disposes of the cursor, releasing resources and unsetting the cache cursor.
